```{r load-historical-data, echo=TRUE}
library(dplyr)

folder <- "/Users/mialevcovich/Desktop/fall courses 2026/ECON 354/econ354 term project"

prices <- read.csv(
  file.path(folder, "House_Price_Index.csv"),
  skip = 2,
  header = FALSE
)

toronto_prices <- prices |>
  filter(grepl("^[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$", V1)) |>
  transmute(
    date = as.Date(sprintf(
      "%s-%02d-01",
      substr(V1, 5, 8),
      match(substr(V1, 1, 3), month.abb)
    )),
    teranet_index = as.numeric(V37)
  )

rates <- read.csv(
  file.path(folder, "RATES_MORTGAGES-2013-01-01.csv"),
  skip = 40
)

mortgage_rates <- rates |>
  transmute(
    date = as.Date(paste0(substr(date, 1, 7), "-01")),
    mortgage_rate_pct = as.numeric(V122667786)
  )

toronto_income <- read.csv(
  file.path(folder, "Total_income_STATCAN.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
) |>
  filter(VECTOR == "v21188037") |>
  transmute(
    year = as.integer(REF_DATE),
    annual_income = as.numeric(VALUE)
  )

toronto <- toronto_prices |>
  inner_join(mortgage_rates, by = "date") |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))) |>
  inner_join(toronto_income, by = "year") |>
  filter(
    is.finite(teranet_index), teranet_index > 0,
    is.finite(mortgage_rate_pct),
    is.finite(annual_income), annual_income > 0
  ) |>
  arrange(date)

stopifnot(nrow(toronto) > 0L)
```

```{r historical-decomposition, echo=TRUE}
amortization_years <- 25
n_payments <- 12 * amortization_years

toronto_decomposition <- toronto |>
  mutate(
    # Convert the quoted annual rate to an effective monthly rate.
    annual_rate = mortgage_rate_pct / 100,
    monthly_rate = (1 + annual_rate / 2)^(1 / 6) - 1,

    # Monthly mortgage payment per dollar borrowed.
    payment_factor = if_else(
      monthly_rate == 0,
      1 / n_payments,
      monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate)^(-n_payments))
    ),

    # Each contribution is measured relative to the first usable year.
    price_contribution = 100 * log(teranet_index / first(teranet_index)),
    rate_contribution = 100 * log(payment_factor / first(payment_factor)),
    income_contribution = -100 * log(annual_income / first(annual_income)),

    total_log_change = price_contribution + rate_contribution +
      income_contribution,

    # Convert log points to an ordinary percentage change in PTI.
    pti_percent_change = 100 * expm1(total_log_change / 100)
  )
```

```{r interactive-decomposition, echo=TRUE}
library(plotly)

monthly <- toronto_decomposition
yearly <- monthly[format(monthly$date, "%m") == "12", ]

# Format the black line's hover label.
net_hover <- function(data) {
  sprintf(
    "%+.2f log points<br>%+.2f%% relative to the starting month",
    data$total_log_change,
    data$pti_percent_change
  )
}

# Supply new dates and values for the three bars and the black line.
view_args <- function(data, hover_format) {
  dates <- format(data$date, "%Y-%m-%d")

  list(
    list(
      x = rep(list(dates), 4),
      y = list(
        data$price_contribution,
        data$rate_contribution,
        data$income_contribution,
        data$total_log_change
      ),
      text = list("", "", "", net_hover(data))
    ),
    list(
      "xaxis.autorange" = TRUE,
      "xaxis.hoverformat" = hover_format
    )
  )
}

plot_ly(monthly, x = ~format(date, "%Y-%m-%d")) |>
  add_bars(
    y = ~price_contribution,
    name = "Home prices",
    hovertemplate = "%{y:+.2f} log points"
  ) |>
  add_bars(
    y = ~rate_contribution,
    name = "Mortgage rates",
    hovertemplate = "%{y:+.2f} log points"
  ) |>
  add_bars(
    y = ~income_contribution,
    name = "Median family income",
    hovertemplate = "%{y:+.2f} log points"
  ) |>
  add_lines(
    y = ~total_log_change,
    name = "Net change in PTI",
    line = list(color = "#222222", width = 3),
    text = net_hover(monthly),
    hovertemplate = "%{text}"
  ) |>
  layout(
    barmode = "relative",
    hovermode = "x unified",
    margin = list(t = 65),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Date",
      type = "date",
      tickformat = "%Y",
      hoverformat = "%b %Y",
      rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE)
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Contribution since the starting month (log points)"),
    updatemenus = list(list(
      type = "buttons",
      direction = "right",
      x = 0,
      xanchor = "left",
      y = 1.15,
      buttons = list(
        list(
          label = "Monthly",
          method = "update",
          args = view_args(monthly, "%b %Y")
        ),
        list(
          label = "Yearly (December)",
          method = "update",
          args = view_args(yearly, "%Y")
        )
      )
    ))
  )
```
